meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 套用「Setup-Conflict-Resolution」叙事框架,把原始数据整理成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告,面向高管等非技术受众输出结论与行动建议。
howto.when: 当你要向高管汇报、做季度业务复盘或投资者演示,或需要把数据洞察讲给非技术受众听时,会接管。

say.text: 帮我把这份季度流失数据做成一页高管汇报的故事
把这组对比数据讲成投资者能听懂的故事并给建议
say.note: 输出对比框架加推荐结论

say.text: 用数据故事格式重写这份月报,突出一个关键洞察
say.note: 会加上标题结论与行动项

howto.what_en: Applies a Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative framework to turn raw data into insight reports that pair visuals with business context for non-technical readers.
howto.when_en: Use it when presenting analytics to executives, preparing quarterly reviews or investor decks, or explaining data insights to non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly churn data into a one-page executive story
say_en.note: Lays it out as Setup, Conflict, Resolution

say_en.text: Tell this comparison data as an investor story with a recommendation
say_en.note: Returns a comparison framework plus a pick

say_en.text: Rewrite this monthly report as a data story with one key insight
say_en.note: Adds a headline conclusion and next steps
